cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)

project(sdm_demo_qt6_thesaurus LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
set(CMAKE_AUTOUIC ON)
set(CMAKE_AUTORCC ON)

find_package(Qt6 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets Sql)

# the models and DAO are headers generated by sdmc (sdmc gen), DataStore.* is the data store (sdmc ds)
add_executable(sdm_demo_qt6_thesaurus WIN32 main.cpp MainForm.cpp MainForm.ui DataStore.cpp Qt_Thesaurus.qrc)
target_link_libraries(sdm_demo_qt6_thesaurus PRIVATE Qt6::Widgets Qt6::Sql)

# the database and the link of the translator: the form opens them next to the exe
add_custom_command(TARGET sdm_demo_qt6_thesaurus POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
            "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/thesaurus.sqlite" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/url.txt"
            "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:sdm_demo_qt6_thesaurus>"
    COMMENT "thesaurus.sqlite, url.txt")

# Qt DLLs, the platform and SQL plug-ins next to the exe: it starts from any button of VS Code, from the
# debugger and by a double click, without C:/Qt/.../bin in PATH
if(WIN32)
    get_target_property(_qmake Qt6::qmake IMPORTED_LOCATION)
    get_filename_component(_qt_bin "${_qmake}" DIRECTORY)
    add_custom_command(TARGET sdm_demo_qt6_thesaurus POST_BUILD
        COMMAND "${_qt_bin}/windeployqt.exe" --no-translations --no-system-d3d-compiler --no-opengl-sw
                "$<TARGET_FILE:sdm_demo_qt6_thesaurus>"
        COMMENT "windeployqt")
endif()
